_doc: Scan-only seo_audit blueprint run: seo_audit_scan -> video chain skips (generate_video unset). Drives analysis_service's SEO scoring engine AND the #398 advanced code path via brief.cross_page_linking (the sitemap cross-page crawl fires on cross_page_linking alone; competitor_urls is validated + forwarded to the scan, but the competitor content-gap analyzer is include_llm-gated in analysis_service and no-ops here since include_llm is false — kept off so this post-promote guard stays deterministic and needs no seeded LLM worker). Terminal `completed` on the scan output; the deliverable is required by /api/projects (min_length=1) but never fulfilled on a scan-only run. distinct_count_gte groups[].group=3 is the real scorecard-is-real guard (9-group catalog is fixed, so this only fails on a malformed/empty 200).
